decisionScope: Locks the ten choices asked immediately before the user's answer. It does not silently answer unrelated D1-D17 decisions in reward-cadence-acceptance-round-004.json.

decisions.lockedDecision: Routine high-volume character and weapon draws use separate abundant tickets. Ruby is required for evolution and may supplement pickup or ticket purchases, but routine mass draws do not consume the mandatory-evolution budget.

N and R characters and weapons remain endgame-relevant through specialist counters, low-cost reset starts, shop or delivery utility, and easier skill completion. They are not disposable onboarding-only content.
UR is generally stronger but can be outperformed in defined encounters by lower rarities with the correct role, counter, evolution, skill level, or economy utility. UR may not dominate every axis.
Reaching the full character or weapon skill cap requires at least twenty additional effective duplicate copies or equivalent duplicate-value units after the first acquisition.
guardrails: The first copy contains the complete advertised core role.
No required combat function is locked behind duplicates.
Marginal power per duplicate diminishes toward the cap.
Selector, exchange, pity, universal fragment, or equivalent deterministic catch-up routes are required.
Duplicate overflow after the cap is never discarded.
The exact curve and whether the final count exceeds twenty remain simulation-dependent; it may not be reduced below twenty without a new user decision.

decisions.lockedDecision: The first strong-new-game reset targets a 20-to-35-minute foreground session, with 35 minutes as the upper target rather than a forced exact timestamp.

Every reset restarts from Floor 1 and delivers very fast re-clear through restored automation, bulk upgrades, known-floor acceleration, saved formation, and saved shop configuration where valid. Mid-tower checkpoint starts are not the default reset model.
Initial product advertising is rewarded opt-in only. Forced interstitial and banner advertising are excluded from the initial product.

Combat characters and weapons may use limited pickup periods only when reruns, deterministic exchange or selection, and same-banner-class pity carryover exist. Permanent miss states and disappearing paid pity are prohibited.

The new-player route guarantees at least one SSR character and one SR-or-better weapon on the first day through disclosed deterministic rewards or beginner banners. This is not merely a reroll recommendation.

PvP, competitive ranking rewards, and guild competition are excluded from the initial product. The product may display personal or non-rewarding tower-reach records without competitive progression rewards.

partiallyResolved.D9: Duplicate depth is fixed at at least twenty additional effective copies. Exact pity counts, pickup guarantee counts, and duplicate conversion values remain unresolved.
